global_rules: Do not overwrite canonical API JSONs during normal generation; copy to a runtime/sandbox file and patch the copy.
Replace TEMPLATE_* and Korean brace placeholders before live ComfyUI submission unless explicitly testing placeholder behavior.
Keep generated images outside this canonical workflow pack.
Do not claim quality or production readiness without artifact/contact-sheet/Ren'Py QA.
When user performs visual QA, report output paths and seeds without inventing visual judgments.

fixed_defaults_observed.identity_reference: none; no-ref txt2img, character consistency from explicit character/outfit tags
fixed_defaults_observed.scene_reference: none; prompt-generated background from blank latent
fixed_defaults_observed.direction: Prefer upper_body for face-critical beats. The target action-safe boundary is the top 0.72 of the frame, derived from 1 - renpy_textbox_fraction; rendered visual QA must verify face, hands, and story prop stay above it. Use at least three distinct seed values, reuse each unchanged in both A and B, and render three matched pairs (six candidates total) when changing framing or action tags. Static CI verifies this configuration contract, not image quality.

fixed_defaults_observed.owner_taste_note: Face quality drops when the character reads as distant. Keep upper_body presets as recommendations; reaching/POV and cowboy-shot blocks are runtime-only experiments that require the matching negative-prompt patch and same-seed rendered review.
fixed_defaults_observed.cinematic_candidate_rule: Use one beat-matched staging block at a time. Static configuration checks cannot establish visual quality; rendered QA must reject candidates when eyes or mouth smear, the story prop disappears/fuses into clothing, hands fail, or the bottom 0.28 textbox hides critical action.

workflows.purpose: Generate separate 16:9 close-up prop, clue, or story cut-in CG images for Ren'Py staging.
workflows.output_type: opaque 16:9 prop close-up CG, 1024x576 by default

workflows.purpose: Generate unified Stable Audio 3 VN audio candidates via logical audio_bgm/audio_sfx role contracts; canonical replacement for the legacy split audio routes.
workflows.output_type: MP3 audio candidate; trim/loop/normalize and convert approved candidate to OGG before RenPy promotion

fixed_defaults_observed.recommended_bgm_duration: 20-30s source candidates for QA; longer only after direction approval and loop/edit planning
fixed_defaults_observed.recommended_sfx_duration: 1.5-2.5s for one-shots; 3-8s for longer foley/magic/ambience-like effects
fixed_defaults_observed.prompt_route: direct prompt first; TextGenerate branch is optional A/B only
fixed_defaults_observed.negative_prompt_default: blank by role contract unless a specific recurrent failure must be suppressed
fixed_defaults_observed.bgm_prompt_shape: instrumentation + musical form/rhythm + mood + short role
fixed_defaults_observed.sfx_prompt_shape: short positive-only natural-language cue + one/two material or timbre colors
fixed_defaults_observed.role_routing: asset_type bgm -> audio_bgm role, asset_type sfx -> audio_sfx role; both execute this same workflow JSON
